data.name: Mashara
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mashara means 'radiant, shining one'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic tradition as it is derived from the Quranic Arabic word 'Mashriq', which refers to the east, symbolizing the rising of the sun and new beginnings. It is a name that evokes feelings of hope, renewal, and spiritual growth.
